entries.answer:
- **Claude Opus 5 (max)** — Context: 1M tokens total, max output 128K. Best-placed benchmarks: FrontierCode 1.1 Extended 63.6% (best verified score), ARC-AGI-3 30.2% (best verified score)[1][2]

- **Claude Fable 5** — Context: 1M tokens. Best-placed benchmarks: SWE-bench Pro 80.0%, FrontierSWE 88.8%[3][4][5][6]

- **GPT-5.6 Sol (max)** — Context: ~1.05M tokens. Best-placed benchmarks: BrowseComp 92.2%, OSWorld 2.0 62.6%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.8%, DeepSWE v1.1 72.7% (also 73.0% in xAI table)[2][7][8]

- **Grok 4.6 (xhigh)** — Context: 500K tokens, no output cap stated. Best-placed benchmarks: GDPVal-AA v2 1,753 Elo, AA-Briefcase 1,577 Elo, Harvey LAB 15.8%[8][9][10]

- **Kimi K3 (max)** — Context: 1,048,576 tokens. Best-placed benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.3%, DeepSWE v1.1 67.5%, FrontierSWE 81.2%[11][12][13]

- **GLM-5.3 (max)** — Context: 1M tokens, max output 128K. Best-placed benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 3.0 28.3%, PostTrainBench 39.8%, AutomationBench v1.0.6 48.2%, CyberGym 84.5%, ExploitGym 105/130, ExploitBench 54.4%[12][14][15]

- **Qwen3.8 Max** — Context: 1M tokens (991K max input / 131K max output). Best-placed benchmarks: PaperBench 93.0%, OSWorld-Verified 86.1%, RealWorldQA 88.0%[16][17]

- **Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B** — Context: native 262,144, extensible to ~1,010,000; max output 131,072. No confirmed first-place benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[18][19]

- **Muse Spark 1.2 (xhigh)** — Context: 1M input, 1M max output. Best-placed benchmarks: Humanity's Last Exam 45.5%, SciCode 56.4%, LCR (long-context reasoning) 83.3%[20]

- **Gemini 3.7 Flash (high)** — Context: 1,048,576 tokens input, 65,536 max output. Best-placed benchmarks: GDM-MRCR v2 (8-needle) 97.0%, WebDev Arena 1,588 Elo[21][22]

- **DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max)** — Context: 1M tokens, max output 384K. Best-placed benchmarks: NL2Repo 61.1%, LiveCodeBench 93.5%, Codeforces rating 3,206, Apex Shortlist Pass@1 90.2%, MRCR 1M 83.5%, CorpusQA 1M 62.0%[23][24][12]

- **Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh)** — Context: native 262,144, extensible to 1M via YaRN. Best-placed benchmarks: IFBench 79.5%, SWE-bench Pro 61.7%, OSWorld-Verified 84.3%, AndroidWorld 81.9%, LiveCodeBench v6 90.3%, MathVision 90.0%[25][26]

- **Motif 3** — Context: 262,144 tokens. Best-placed benchmark: ITBench 51.5%[27][28]

- **MiniMax-M3** — Context: 1M tokens (per MiniMax/API cards; NVIDIA NeMo lists 512K for the VLM variant). Best-placed benchmarks: GPQA Diamond 92.9%, IFBench 82.9%, Terminal-Bench Hard 42.4%[29][30]

- **DeepSeek V4 Pro (max)** — Context: 1M tokens, max output 384K. Best-placed benchmarks: LiveCodeBench 93.5%, Codeforces rating 3,206, Apex Shortlist Pass@1 90.2%, MRCR 1M 83.5%, CorpusQA 1M 62.0%[24][31][23]

- **MiMo-V2.5-Pro** — Context: 1,048,576 tokens. Best-placed benchmarks: ranked #1 among open-source models on GDPVal-AA and ClawEval; leads long-context retrieval at 512K/1M tokens (0.56 BFS/0.92 Parents at 512K)[32][33][34]

- **Inkling** — Context: native 1M tokens (hosted Tinker service currently exposes 64K/256K). No confirmed first-place benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[35]

- **Hy3** — Context: 256K tokens (262,144), max output ~131K. Best-placed benchmark: τ²-Bench 92.7%[36][37]

- **Ling 3.0 Flash** — Context: 262,144 tokens, max output 16K. No confirmed first-place benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[38][39]
